# PROCESS — cand_0002 (parent cand_0001, val 0.571)

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks (failing trials) | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | A: agent miscomputes the price of a flight/cabin change (forgets ×passengers, forgets that cabin applies to ALL flights) and writes on a wrong quote | 10 (t1: quoted $495, real $1302; t4: quoted $670, real $2010), 44 (t4 quoted per-leg) | no compute tool; write tool accepts any call | BEHAVIORAL + CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW compute tool `quote_reservation_update` + required `expected_charge` guard in update_reservation_flights |
| 2 | B: "I can't get an upgrade quote" → transfer / gives up | 44 (t1 transfer, t2) | no way to price a cabin change before doing it | CAPABILITY-GAP | same quote tool + transfer docstring narrowing |
| 3 | C: agent believes basic economy can't change cabin, or changes flights when upgrading | 44 (t2, t4) | knowledge misread; update tool takes a full flight list | KNOWLEDGE + BEHAVIORAL | NEW composite write `change_reservation_cabin` (keeps flights in code) + `allowed_modifications` in get_reservation_details + actionable basic-economy error |
| 4 | D: agent refuses user's request to split passengers into separate reservations (to use one certificate each) | 23 (t0, t2, t3 → refusal/transfer) | wrongly reads "same flights/one cert" as forbidding multiple reservations | KNOWLEDGE (decision, refuse→act) | docstring rule + certificate-limit error note (only when >1 passenger) |
| 5 | E: needless transfer (seat request; denied cancellation) | 8 t0 (seats), 35 t1 (after refusing cancel, user said no transfer) | transfer criteria vague | KNOWLEDGE | narrowing docstring on transfer_to_human_agents + seat note on book_reservation |
| 6 | F: bags copied from old reservation | 35 t4 (total_baggages=1) | agent copied bag count | KNOWLEDGE | param doc line |
| 7 | G: cancels a non-conflicting reservation in "double-booked" task | 42 t2 (cancelled MFRB94) | agent must reason about same-day overlaps across 7 reservations | CAPABILITY-GAP | NEW read tool `find_overlapping_reservations` |
| 8 | H (latent bug from iter 1): balance check for gift card/certificate only ran for the LAST payment method | book_reservation | indentation bug | correctness | move check into per-method loop (restores tau2 semantics) |
| — | 23 t4 route changed to SEA; 44 t0 NM1VX1 judged on round-trip total / user chose gift card | 23, 44 | reasoning / user-sim choice | — | skipped (no safe predicate) |

## Changes made (tools/tools.py)
| cluster | edit class | tool | what & why it generalizes | blast radius |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A,B | NEW compute tool | quote_reservation_update | prices any cabin/flight change via a shared helper `_price_flight_update` (exact same math as the write tool) and returns total_charge + human summary | READ-only, new tool; BOUNDED |
| A | in-body guard + new required param | update_reservation_flights(expected_charge) | refuses if expected_charge ≠ real price, returns the real amount and "re-confirm with user" | fires only on wrong quotes. Passing task 20 never updates. |
| C | NEW composite write | change_reservation_cabin | builds the flight list from the reservation itself, delegates to update | only new path; same DB effect as gold (verified) |
| C | enriched return | get_reservation_details.allowed_modifications | states cabin change allowed (also basic economy) / flight change allowed or not | additive fields |
| C | actionable error | basic-economy guard (now `_basic_economy_flight_change_error`) | error points to quote + change_reservation_cabin | fires only on violation |
| D | knowledge docstring + error note | book_reservation | separate reservations per passenger allowed; note appended to count-limit error only when >1 passenger | 20 (1 passenger) never sees the note |
| E | narrowing docstring | transfer_to_human_agents, book_reservation | don't transfer for denied requests (except flown→cancel), user refusal, price quotes, seats | narrows only; no val gold contains a transfer |
| F | param doc | book_reservation.total_baggages | never copy bags from another reservation | doc only |
| G | NEW read tool | find_overlapping_reservations | groups active reservations by (date, passenger); lists only real same-day conflicts; doc says never cancel unlisted ones | READ-only |
| H | bug fix | book_reservation | per-method balance check | fires only on overdraw (tau2 original also raises) |

## Verify-the-fix (script /tmp/capev/verify.py + verify2.py, real tau2 db.json, original tau2 toolkit as reference)
- A: trace 10 t1 args (HAT131.., expected 495) → RAISE "real total_charge is 1302"; trace 10 t4 (HAT190.., expected 670) → RAISE "real 2010" — both > user's $1000 limit, so the user declines → gold no-op DB. Quote for both returns the same numbers.
- A safe: economy date change on 4NQLHD with quoted expected_charge (39) → DB identical to original tau2 update.
- B/C: quote NM1VX1/KC18K6/H8Q05L business → 484/740/163 (163 matches the agent's correct manual quote in 44 t0); change_reservation_cabin with those quotes → DB identical to gold's 3 update_reservation_flights calls. Trace 44 t4 (NM1VX1 with HAT141) → RAISE with pointer to change_reservation_cabin.
- D: 3 certificates on a 3-passenger booking → error includes split note; gold 23 (cancel + 3 single-passenger bookings) → DB identical to gold. Task 20 two certificates (1 passenger) → error WITHOUT split note.
- G: find_overlapping_reservations(sophia_martin_4574) → only 2024-05-17 {FDZ0T5, 5BGGWZ} and 2024-05-22 {PUNERT, HSR97W}; MFRB94/HTR26G/SE9KEL not listed (gold cancels FDZ0T5 + HSR97W).
- H: gift card 198 asked for 500 as non-last method → RAISE (previously would pass).
- Passing task 20 gold booking and task 8 gold booking → DB identical to original.
- Registration: get_tools() lists 17 tools incl. the 3 new ones.

## Process & features used
- Serial: 35 traces diagnosed with a summarizer script (gold actions + every write call + its result); edits cluster in one file with a shared helper, so fan-out/merge would add conflict risk for no gain.
- Read prior_iterations/cand_0001 PROCESS + diff: kept all its guards; restructured its basic-economy guard into a helper (same predicate).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- `_price_flight_update` is the single source of pricing for quote and update — keep them in sync.
- Cancellation guard still allows booked-within-24h (23 gold) and business (42 gold).

## Deliberately skipped
- 23 t4 changed destination to SEA: no general predicate tells "user wanted the same route".
- 44 t0 interpretation of "≤3h" over round-trip total; and user choosing gift card — not tool defects.
- A layover/total-duration field: would push 44 agent to exclude KC18K6 (gold upgrades it).
